name: @pipeworx/mcp-paleobiodb

tools.name: find_fossils
tools.description: Find fossil occurrences for a taxon from the Paleobiology Database (the global fossil record). Returns occurrences with collection locations (lat/lng, country) and geologic ages. base_name matching includes the taxon and all of its subtaxa. Ages are in millions of years (Ma). Keyless.

taxon.description: Taxon name, e.g. "Tyrannosaurus" or "Mammalia". Matches the taxon and all subtaxa.

interval.description: Geologic time interval (period/epoch) to filter by, e.g. "Cretaceous".

country.description: Two-letter country code to filter by, e.g. "US".

tools.name: get_taxon
tools.description: Look up a single taxon in the Paleobiology Database: its taxonomic rank, attribution (author + year), first/last appearance intervals and ages (in millions of years, Ma), and number of subtaxa. Keyless.

name.description: Taxon name to look up, e.g. "Tyrannosaurus rex".

tools.name: list_subtaxa
tools.description: List the direct child taxa (subtaxa) of a taxon from the Paleobiology Database, with each child's rank and number of its own subtaxa. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-paleobiodb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the paleobiodb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
